T:P1.11.text: These targets set specific and measurable goals that build on the company’s announcement to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions 28% by the end of the decade.

T:P1.12.text: Reach Zero Waste to Landfill at 97% of its Production Facilities

T:P1.13.text: By reducing, recycling, composting, reusing, and incinerating with energy recovery, Greif targets 97% of its production facilities achieving zero-waste to landfills.

T:P1.15.text: Working across a vast portfolio of raw materials and products, Greif recyclability targets will be benchmarked by weight, and consolidated at a company level.

T:P1.16.text: Achieve an Average of 60% Recycled Raw Material Content Across Products

T:P1.17.text: Recycled content targets for Greif products are minimum averages benchmarked across a portfolio of materials and products by weight, consolidated at a company level.

T:P1.19.text: Greif is on track to ensure colleagues receive equal pay for equal work and is committed to maintaining gender pay parity.

T:P1.20.text: Evaluate the Sustainability Performance for 80% of Total Spend with Suppliers
